```{r, warning=F, message=F}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(msigdbr)






# 11.1. Import data


data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"

# Import full VST matrix
full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "vst_full.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F, check.names=F, row.names=1)

# Convert rownames (ENSG) to a column and map to gene symbols
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F) %>%
  { `names<-`(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }

full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene[gene],
    gene_symbol = ifelse(is.na(gene_symbol), gene, gene_symbol))

# Import metadata
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

# Import microbe reports
microbe_reports_bgfilter <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "microbe_reports_bgfilter.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

# Import protein matrix
protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path("C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data/protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)






# 11.2. Select IFN plots


# Ensure same patients are used
microbe_reports_bgfilter <- microbe_reports_bgfilter %>%
  filter(sample_name %in% metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name)

# Filter to viruses only
virus_reports <- microbe_reports_bgfilter %>%
  filter(category == "viruses") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_name = factor(
      sample_name,
      levels = metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name)) %>%
  arrange(sample_name)

# Run by sum viral rpm
viral_rpm_df <- virus_reports %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  summarize(
    viral_rpm = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm=T))

# Add back all patients (patients with no viral rpm included with 0)
viral_rpm_df <- metadata_df_with_folds %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_name, LRTI_adjudication) %>%
  left_join(viral_rpm_df, by = "sample_name") %>%
  mutate(
    viral_rpm = ifelse(is.na(viral_rpm), 0, viral_rpm)
  )






# 11.2a. Select Gene IFNs


ifn_genes <- c("ISG15", "IFIT2", "IFIT3")

rna_ifn_long <- full_vsd %>%
  filter(gene_symbol %in% ifn_genes) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(gene, gene_symbol),
    names_to = "sample_name",
    values_to = "expr"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  mutate(expr_scaled = as.numeric(scale(expr))) %>%
  ungroup()

ifn_rna_df <- rna_ifn_long %>%
  left_join(
    viral_rpm_df %>% 
      dplyr::select(sample_name, viral_rpm, LRTI_adjudication),
    by = "sample_name"
  )

# Restrict to Definite LRTI only
ifn_rna_df_definite <- ifn_rna_df %>%
  filter(LRTI_adjudication == "Definite")





# 11.2b. Select Protein IFNs


ifn_proteins <- c("ISG15", "IFIT2", "IFIT3")

protein_ifn_long <- protein_mat %>%
  { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
  mutate(patient_id = as.integer(patient_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, all_of(ifn_proteins)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -patient_id,
    names_to = "gene_symbol",
    values_to = "expr_log2"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  mutate(expr_scaled = as.numeric(scale(expr_log2))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    metadata_df_with_folds %>%
      dplyr::select(patient_id, sample_name),
      by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    viral_rpm_df,
    by = "sample_name"
  ) %>%
  filter(LRTI_adjudication == "Definite") %>%
  mutate(modality = "Protein")

ifn_rna_df_definite <- ifn_rna_df_definite %>%
  mutate(modality = "RNA")






# 11.2c. Combine RNA/Protein


ifn_combined_df <- bind_rows(
  ifn_rna_df_definite %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_name, gene_symbol, expr_scaled, viral_rpm, modality),
  protein_ifn_long %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_name, gene_symbol, expr_scaled, viral_rpm, modality)
)






# 11.2d. Viral RPM vs IFN plot


omics_colors <- c(
  "RNA" = "#4C72B0",
  "Protein" = "#55A868"
)

cor_ifn_df <- ifn_combined_df %>%
  group_by(modality, gene_symbol) %>%
  summarize(
    pearson_r = cor.test(expr_scaled, log10(viral_rpm + 1), method="pearson")$estimate,
    pearson_p = cor.test(expr_scaled, log10(viral_rpm + 1), method="pearson")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pearson_padj = p.adjust(pearson_p, method="BH"),
         pearson_padj_fmt = signif(pearson_padj, 2))

interaction_p_df <- ifn_combined_df %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarize(
    interaction_p = summary(lm(
      expr_scaled ~ log10(viral_rpm + 1) * as.character(modality),
      data = cur_data()
    ))$coefficients["log10(viral_rpm + 1):as.character(modality)RNA", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
ggplot(
  ifn_combined_df,
  aes(
    x = log10(viral_rpm + 1),
    y = expr_scaled,
    color = modality)
  ) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.6) +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, alpha=0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_text(
  data = cor_ifn_df %>%
    group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
    mutate(
      y_pos = case_when(
        modality == "RNA" ~ 3.8,      # RNA on top
        modality == "Protein" ~ 3.45  # Protein just below
      )
    ),
  aes(
    x = max(log10(ifn_combined_df$viral_rpm + 1)) * 0.98,
    y = y_pos,
    label = paste0(modality, ": r = ", round(pearson_r, 2), ", Padj = ", pearson_padj_fmt)
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 3,
  hjust = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
  data = interaction_p_df,
  aes(
    x = max(log10(ifn_combined_df$viral_rpm + 1)) * 0.98,
    y = 3.1,
    label = paste0("interaction p = ", round(interaction_p, 3))
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 3,
  hjust = 1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_symbol) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 3.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = omics_colors) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    axis.text        = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.text      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3)
  ) +
  labs(
  x = expression(log[10]~"Viral RPM (+1)"),
  y = "Standardized abundance (z-score)",
  title = "Viral Load–Dependent IFN Expression",
  subtitle = "RNA and protein shown separately for each IFN"
)

# Save plot
ggsave(
  filename    = file.path(results_dir, "Viral_RPM_vs_IFN_RNA_Protein.pdf"),
  plot        = last_plot(),
  width       = 9,
  height      = 5,
  device      = "pdf",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)






# 11.3. Composite IFN score plot

# 11.3a. Calculate RNA score

ifn_score_df <- rna_ifn_hallmark_long %>%

  ungroup() %>%

summary(ifn_score_df$IFN_score)
nrow(ifn_score_df)

# Merge with viral RPM and LRTI adjudication info

# Filter to Definite LRTI cases only
ifn_score_plot_df_definite <- ifn_score_plot_df %>%

ifn_score_plot_df_definite <- ifn_score_plot_df_definite %>%

protein_ifn_score_df <- protein_ifn_hallmark_long %>%

# 11.4a. Score calculation function


calc_ifn_score <- function(gene_set, label) {

  # RNA score
  rna_score <- full_vsd %>%
    filter(gene_symbol %in% gene_set) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol), names_to="sample_name", values_to="expr") %>%
    group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
    mutate(expr_scaled = as.numeric(scale(expr))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(sample_name) %>%
    summarize(IFN_score = mean(expr_scaled, na.rm=T), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(modality = "RNA")

  # Protein score
  prot_genes_available <- intersect(gene_set, colnames(protein_mat)[-1])

  prot_score <- protein_mat %>%
    { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.integer(patient_id)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols=-patient_id, names_to="gene_symbol", values_to="expr_log2") %>%
    filter(gene_symbol %in% prot_genes_available) %>%
    left_join(metadata_df_with_folds %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, sample_name), by="patient_id") %>%
    group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
    mutate(expr_scaled = as.numeric(scale(expr_log2))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(sample_name) %>%
    summarize(IFN_score = mean(expr_scaled, na.rm=T), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(modality = "Protein")

  # Combine and add viral RPM + filter to Definite
  bind_rows(rna_score, prot_score) %>%
    left_join(viral_rpm_df %>% dplyr::select(sample_name, viral_rpm, LRTI_adjudication),
              by="sample_name") %>%
    filter(LRTI_adjudication == "Definite") %>%
    mutate(ifn_type = label)
}

ifn_alpha_df <- calc_ifn_score(ifn_alpha_genes, "IFNα")
ifn_gamma_df <- calc_ifn_score(ifn_gamma_genes, "IFNγ")






# 11.4b. Plot function


plot_ifn_score <- function(score_df, ifn_label, filename) {

  cor_df <- score_df %>%
    group_by(modality) %>%
    summarize(
      pearson_r = cor.test(IFN_score, log10(viral_rpm + 1), method="pearson")$estimate,
      pearson_p = cor.test(IFN_score, log10(viral_rpm + 1), method="pearson")$p.value,
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      pearson_padj     = p.adjust(pearson_p, method="BH"),
      pearson_padj_fmt = signif(pearson_padj, 2),
      y_pos = case_when(
        modality == "RNA"     ~ -1.3,
        modality == "Protein" ~ -1.5
        ))

  interaction_p <- summary(lm(
    IFN_score ~ log10(viral_rpm + 1) * as.character(modality),
    data = score_df
  ))$coefficients["log10(viral_rpm + 1):as.character(modality)RNA", "Pr(>|t|)"]

  p <- ggplot(score_df, aes(x=log10(viral_rpm + 1), y=IFN_score, color=modality)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=1.8) +
    geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, alpha=0.15) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey40") +
    geom_text(
      data = cor_df,
        aes(
          x = max(log10(score_df$viral_rpm + 1)) * 0.98,
          y = y_pos - 0.2,
          label = paste0(modality, ": r = ", round(pearson_r, 2), ", Padj = ", pearson_padj_fmt)),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          size = 4,
          hjust = 1
    ) +
    annotate("text",
      x = max(log10(score_df$viral_rpm + 1)) * 0.98,
      y = -1.9,
      label = paste0("Interaction p = ", signif(interaction_p, 2)),
      size = 4,
      hjust = 1
      ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.0, 1.5)) +
    scale_color_manual(values=omics_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size=13, base_family="Helvetica") +
    theme(
      axis.text        = element_text(face="bold", color="black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(face="bold"),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.text      = element_text(face="bold"),
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      plot.title       = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust=0.5, color="grey30"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color="grey92", linewidth=0.3)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = expression(log[10]~"Viral RPM (+1)"),
      y = paste0("Composite ", ifn_label, " score (z-score)"),
      title = paste0("Viral Load vs Composite ", ifn_label, " Response"),
      subtitle = paste0("Hallmark ", ifn_label, " pathway (RNA and protein)")
    )

  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, filename), plot=p, width=7, height=5,
         device="pdf", useDingbats=FALSE)
}



plot_ifn_score(ifn_alpha_df, "IFNα", "Composite_IFNalpha_score_vs_Viral_RPM.pdf")

plot_ifn_score(ifn_gamma_df, "IFNγ", "Composite_IFNgamma_score_vs_Viral_RPM.pdf")
```
